subject: science
chapter_title: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body

concepts.title: Nutrients: Components of Food
concepts.definition: Food supplies nutrients: carbohydrates and fats mainly give energy, while proteins build and repair the body; each meal should gather all these components in the right amounts.
concepts.formula: food = carbohydrates + fats + proteins + vitamins + minerals + fibre + water
concepts.key_idea: Every nutrient has a job: energy, building or regulation, and no single food supplies them all.

concepts.title: Vitamins, Minerals and Fibre
concepts.definition: Vitamins and minerals are protective nutrients needed in tiny amounts, fibre helps clear the intestine, and water carries nutrients and controls body processes; their lack causes deficiency diseases.
concepts.key_idea: Small doses, big effects: vitamins and minerals guard the body that energy nutrients build and fuel.

concepts.title: Testing Food for Nutrients
concepts.definition: Nutrients announce themselves under simple tests: iodine turns blue-black on starch, copper sulphate and caustic soda turn violet for protein, and a translucent patch on paper betrays fat.
concepts.key_idea: Chemical tests make the invisible visible: colour changes reveal what a food contains.

concepts.title: Mindful Eating and Deficiency Diseases
concepts.definition: The subhashita's advice, eat what is wholesome, in moderation, in season, sums up mindful eating; a balanced diet rich in all components prevents deficiency diseases and keeps the body healthy.
concepts.key_idea: Eating right is a daily discipline: variety, moderation and season together build health.
